text:
liz: Strange billing in the dogfood walkthrough. After rotating a project key our demo started using the org key. Quick dump:

liz: repro steps:
```
export RW_API_KEY_PROJECT=proj-77aa
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=org-8888
./run-demo --env
# rotate proj-77aa via console
# subsequent requests seen with org-8888 in Authorization
```

omar: I inspected the loader. A recent refactor introduced a fastpath that prefers REDWOOD_API_KEY during hot-reload. That means more-specific envs can be shadowed at runtime. Log: auth.loader picked=REDWOOD_API_KEY (org) when re-evaluating envs.

kevin: This also hits realtime features. Our SSE client keeps the original header and when the project key rotates we get 401s. SDK currently closes the stream; there's no refresh+retry. We should try one refresh via tokenProvider, swap header, then retry the heartbeat/frame once before giving up.

olmar: +1 to one retry. Also suggest making precedence explicit and discoverable: order = RW_API_KEY_PROJECT, RW_API_KEY_SERVICE, RW_API_KEY_ORG, REDWOOD_API_KEY. Put a single masked diag line at startup: "auth.selected=RW_API_KEY_PROJECT (****77aa)" so users see which key took effect.

kevin: Add a one-time WARN if legacy and scoped keys coexist, e.g., "WARN: REDWOOD_API_KEY and RW_API_KEY_* both set; this may cause unexpected billing". Telemetry: emit sdk.auth.conflict_detected (anonymized) so we can measure impact; allow opt-out via RW_AUTH_TELEMETRY=false.

liz: For migrations add RW_LEGACY_KEY_COMPAT=true which keeps old behavior for one release. Also document the recommended fix: unset REDWOOD_API_KEY or prefer RW_API_KEY_PROJECT for project-scoped apps.

omar: I'll submit a small PR to: 1) restore strict precedence, 2) add startup diag + masked warn, 3) wire telemetry ping.

kevin: I'll implement the stream refresh behavior (tokenProvider.refresh() + single retry) and add a sampleapp example showing graceful resume. It will be enabled by default via RW_ENABLE_TOKEN_REFRESH=true.

ci-bot: opened issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/2102 "sdk: auth env precedence + stream token refresh on rotation"

prisma-bot: created branch feat/auth-precedence-stream-retry by omar

liz: Tests: small unit matrix for env permutations, an integration that rotates keys during an active SSE/WS client and asserts either resume or an explicit rotation_failed event. Make sure logs include the masked selected key.

omar: tiny UX note: keep env names under RW_API_KEY_* namespace (suffix like RW_API_KEY_PROJECT) so tooling can auto-complete them.

kevin: I'll add an interoperability test for our CLI too (rw start warns when both envs present).

liz: Thanks everyone. Prioritize the WARN + diag so new onboards are not silently mis-billed, then follow with stream retry. Closing thread; will reopen if we see more anomalies. :white_check_mark:
